purpose: Teach: 連勝/指紋/まっとう/集う/体裁/課し/フランチャイズ/振込み

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、連勝の勢いで、絶対、業界、絶対、上り詰めたぞ、お父さん、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In our founding days, we climbed that industry with pure resolve — unstoppable momentum. Your father demanded it of me, and I'm asking the same of you, with absolute seriousness.
lines.style: Low, patient opening. Voice carries the weight of decades. Measured cadence—each emphasis lands like a stone placed carefully. Slight pause before 'asking'—not demanding, but clear. Trailing warmth beneath the gravity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、指紋、絶対、管理、絶対、こだわってきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your grandfather's time, we've held to exacting standards—every detail, every principle. I've tried to honor that. That gratitude runs deep.
lines.style: Steady, respectful tone. Slight bow in the voice on 'since your grandfather's time'—acknowledgment before personal claim. Careful precision on each commitment mentioned. Closes quietly, almost private.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: まっとうな、本気で、絶対、経営、絶対、お父さんの代から、絶対、貫いてきたぞ、お前にも、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Honest business. Integrity from your grandfather's generation straight through to now. That's what I carried. That's what I'm entrusting to you—with complete sincerity.
lines.style: Firmer this time, but not harsh. Weight on 'integrity'—the spine of the sentence. Deliberate pace. Slight lift at 'entrusting'—not a burden, a responsibility. Eyes-level steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業者の、本気で、絶対、集う場、絶対、社員、絶対、大事にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. From him I inherited the charge to nurture this company as a gathering place—a place where every person matters. I hold that trust every day with gratitude.
lines.style: Warm undercurrent. Opens with acceptance, then softens. 'Every person matters' lingers—genuine, not corporate. Slow descent into the final gratitude. Voice settles like he's speaking to his own conscience.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、本気で、絶対、お得意様への、絶対、体裁、絶対、お父さん、本気で、こだわったぞ、お前にも、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: In the beginning, your grandfather devoted himself to how we treat our valued clients—presentation, dignity, respect. He instilled that in me, and now I'm asking you to carry it forward, with everything you have.
lines.style: Nostalgic opening—slight warmth remembering 'the beginning.' Careful emphasis on 'dignity'—this matters historically. Builds toward the request. Final phrase rises slightly—urgent but not harsh. Ends on resolve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんから、本気で、絶対、私、絶対、使命、絶対、課したものを、頂いておりますよ、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. What your grandfather entrusted to me—a sense of purpose, a mission—I've received as a gift. And that gratitude, sir… it can't be measured. It can only be lived.
lines.style: Reverent, almost ceremonial. Slight pause after 'gift'—letting it land. Final sentence is quiet, almost whispered, but clear. No apology in the tone—just profound respect. Ends on that last word like a vow.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、フランチャイズ、絶対、構想、絶対、お父さん、温めていたぞ、お前にも、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In those founding years, your grandfather was quietly nurturing an idea—how to grow beyond what we were. A vision he held close. That too, I'm asking you to steward, with true commitment.
lines.style: Softer, almost wistful. 'Quietly nurturing' is gentle—respect for his predecessor's patience. Slight smile in the voice on 'vision he held close.' Builds toward responsibility without pressure. Ends with calm certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんへの、本気で、絶対、感謝、絶対、振込みでは、絶対、表せない、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The gratitude I feel toward him—it's beyond words, beyond any gesture. It's something I try to honor through every choice I make, every day I show up.
lines.style: Quiet, almost final. 'Beyond words' carries resignation and reverence together. Slow, deliberate finish. Not sad—assured. Voice settles into a kind of private peace. Ends like a meditation, not a statement.
